projects.title: Electronic Business Permits and Licensing System (eBPLS)
projects.tagline: A full-stack platform that streamlines business permit processing, assessment, payment, and document generation.
projects.description: The Electronic Business Permits and Licensing System (eBPLS) is a full-stack web application designed to modernize and automate business permit processing workflows. The system provides dedicated portals for Applicants, BPLO Officers, Treasury Officers, Barangay Officers, and System Administrators. It supports permit applications, document verification, fee assessment, payment processing, audit logging, PDF document generation, and workflow tracking. The platform was designed with scalability, security, and process automation in mind, implementing role-based access control, secure file management, and integrated online payment processing.
features: Role-based access control for Applicants, BPLO, Treasury, Barangay, and Administrators
Business permit application and processing workflow
Document upload and verification system
Treasury assessment and payment management
PayMongo online payment integration
Automated permit, receipt, and clearance PDF generation
Audit logging and activity tracking
Secure file storage using Supabase Storage
Workflow state management and status tracking
Email notification system for application updates

challenges.problem: Managing complex workflows involving multiple departments and approval stages.
challenges.solution: Implemented a backend-enforced state machine to validate application status transitions and ensure process integrity.

challenges.problem: Securely processing and verifying online payments.
challenges.solution: Integrated PayMongo webhooks with HMAC verification and idempotency controls to prevent duplicate transaction processing.

projects.learnings: This project deepened my understanding of full-stack architecture, workflow automation, REST API design, authentication, database modeling, payment gateway integration, and enterprise-level software development practices.
projects.unavailable_reason: Source code is private. Live demonstration is available.

projects.title: Hanap Medisina Offline
projects.tagline: An offline AI-powered mobile application for identifying Philippine medicinal plants.
projects.description: Hanap Medisina Offline is a React Native mobile application that enables users to identify Philippine medicinal plants using an on-device TensorFlow Lite model. Built with an offline-first architecture, the application provides instant plant identification, educational content, medicinal plant profiles, scan history, favorites, and local data management without requiring internet connectivity. The system was designed to be accessible in remote areas where internet access may be limited or unavailable.
features: Offline medicinal plant identification using TensorFlow Lite
Real-time camera-based plant scanning
Detailed medicinal plant information and references
Favorites and personal plant collection
Scan history with confidence scores
Offline-first architecture with zero cloud dependencies
Import and export of scan history data
Local plant database and educational content
Daily featured plants and trivia
Search and filter functionality

challenges.problem: Running machine learning inference efficiently on mobile devices without internet access.
challenges.solution: Integrated TensorFlow Lite with React Native and optimized model loading and prediction workflows for on-device classification.

challenges.problem: Providing a complete user experience without relying on cloud services.
challenges.solution: Implemented an offline-first architecture using local JSON data, AsyncStorage persistence, and bundled application assets.

projects.learnings: This project expanded my experience in mobile development, AI integration, TensorFlow Lite deployment, offline-first architecture, state management, and building practical machine learning applications for real-world use cases.
projects.unavailable_reason: Mobile application. Source code is available, but no public web deployment is available.
